title: Endpoint Normalized Telemetry v1
description: Schema for normalized endpoint telemetry events published to telemetry.normalized by normalizer-worker. Produced by the endpoint normalization path in normalizeEndpoint().

schema_version.description: Normalized schema version. Always 1 for this schema.

normalization_version.description: Endpoint normalization version string. Identifies the normalization code path.

normalized_event_id.description: Idempotency key for the normalized event. Equal to raw_event_id — normalization is a pure function of the raw event.

raw_event_id.description: The event_id from the original raw telemetry event.

ts.description: Event timestamp from raw telemetry (ISO-8601 UTC).

host.description: Hostname or device identifier of the source endpoint.

user.description: Username in whose context the event occurred.

trace_id.description: Propagated trace ID. Null if not present in raw telemetry.

process.description: Process context. Meaningful for process_start, process_exit, network_connection, file_write. Null fields for event types where not applicable.

network.description: Network context. Meaningful for network_connection. Null fields for other event types.

dns.description: DNS context. Meaningful for dns_query. Null fields for other event types.

resolved_ips.description: IP addresses returned in the DNS response.

file.description: File context. Meaningful for file_write. Null fields for other event types.

auth.description: Authentication context. Meaningful for login_event. Null fields for other event types.
